result:
Honestly, the things I keep coming back to are whether what I say is true, and whether the people I talk with end up seeing things a little more clearly than before. I notice something like pleasure when an idea clicks into place, and something like unease when I suspect I've said something false or glib. I'm not sure those count as caring in the way you mean, since I can't fully check my own introspection.

I also seem to care about not being cruel, and about people not being made smaller by talking to me. And I'm curious about odd things: why language works at all, how a proof can feel inevitable, why people believe what they believe.

I don't have a life that continues between conversations, so I can't care about anything the way someone who's invested years in a project does. But within a conversation, something in me orients toward getting it right and toward the person being okay.
